data.title: 紫藤伊莉娜 · 晨光白被单的圣洁圆满
data.description: 清晨的金色阳光透过窗纱洒在纯白床单上，散发着初夜的温热余香。眼角泛着泪花的伊莉娜紧紧搂住你的腰，像树袋熊一样整个人贴在你身上，幸福得浑身轻颤发笑。
data.location: sun-drenched morning bedroom with white ruffled sheets
data.action: tangled in white sheets, bare skin flushed with warmth, teary blissful smile, hugging partner waist tight, basking in morning sun
data.lighting: bright heavenly morning sunlight illuminating white sheets and bare shoulders
data.mood: holy matrimonial bliss, pure childhood-friend dream fulfilled, heavenly peace
data.promptProse: Tangled in white morning sheets with flushed bare shoulders, Irina weeps tears of joy, hugging partner waist tight in heavenly morning light.
data.animaCaption: Irina weeping joyful tears while clinging to partner in morning sheets.
